If any one of you go with them, pls take complete package from start to end, including Toll, Packing, Driver DA etc. otherwise Driver like Pappu Jha will spoil your trip.

My worst experience with a travel agent in last 20years of travel. BIG NO for Sushma Travel. No matter how good an owner is, actual people running the show can spoil client relation.

Adding to your reply. Your driver took Parking money, when we asked for receipt, he said no receipt was given to him. At Marpo garden he took Rs200 for Parking and there was no parking charges. Please see attached Photo. Anyways leave, looks like for you customer is at fault and not your Driver. Made a big mistake by taking your service, should have gone with agents like Savaari, MMT etc where customer feedback is taken positively, and staff mistakes are not covered up.

featured_reviews.name: ANJANA SANE
featured_reviews.review_text:
We arranged our trip with Sushma Travels. While most aspects of the service were good, we would like to raise a serious concern. The driver assigned to us had just completed another tour and was given only a 4-hour break before starting our journey. This is extremely unsafe.

Our journey began at 11 PM, and throughout the night, the driver appeared drowsy and was dozing off while driving. This created a very dangerous situation for all passengers. Due to safety concerns, not a single passenger was able to sleep during the entire night journey.

We strongly request the travel company to ensure that drivers are well-rested before assigning them to long trips, as passenger safety should be the top priority.

featured_reviews.name: Ashley Joseph
featured_reviews.review_text:
Booked an AC Traveller for a family trip and the experience was extremely disappointing.

The vehicle provided was not as promised. The AC was not functioning properly and had to be switched off repeatedly due to mechanical issues, forcing us to endure the summer heat despite specifically paying for an AC vehicle. There were no curtains, the music system was not working, and parts of the luggage rack were loose, breaking and falling on passengers during the journey, which was both unsafe and unacceptable.

What made the situation worse was the lack of support from the host, Jackie, and the owner, Vinay Singh. Instead of addressing our concerns or offering any practical solution, they were uncooperative and gave vague comparisons to Ola and Uber rather than taking responsibility for the condition of the vehicle and the inconvenience caused.

This was our second booking with them. The first experience was satisfactory, which is why we chose them again. Unfortunately, the second experience was the complete opposite and by far the worst. Not only was our comfort ignored, but our time, money, and energy were wasted dealing with problems that should never have occurred in the first place.

I would strongly advise future customers to verify the condition of the vehicle before booking.
